messages:
nicole: Heads-up: two enterprise pilots asked for a formal "preserve customer network" upgrade lane so their CIDRs and peering IPs are never reassigned during upgrades. Need a short decision and owner list.

ram: Quick scope question: is this purely installer config or do we need runtime changes (KV persistence, migration)?

nicole: Both. Pilots want a toggle in the installer/console and a migration step that re-injects peer IPs & certs. They also need an airgapped upgrade path.

yara: Proposal: expose `network.preserve: true` in manifests. When enabled installer will: 1) persist allocations to a cluster PV or external KV (no TTL), 2) skip automatic rebinds, 3) run a migration job post-upgrade to reapply peer sessions.

felix: Important: preflight must validate reserved CIDRs don't overlap. Sample check command: `redwoodctl preflight --check-reserved 10.200.0.0/24`. Failure message should show remediation steps and `--force-operator-approve` hint.

ram: SLA/UX: preserve lane should be opt-in and documented that upgrades can take longer (15-30m) and may require an operator approval window. Default lane keeps current SLOs.

yara: Telemetry: field wants an opt-in, privacy-safe heartbeat we can use to confirm post-upgrade peer adjacency and no IP collisions. Minimal JSON: `{status: "ok", preserved_ranges: ["10.200.0.0/24"], peers_up: true}`. Must be toggleable.

nicole: Launch criteria draft: (1) installer accepts `network.preserve` and supports reserved_ranges; (2) preflight check implemented and clear errors; (3) migration job and `--retain-network-state` flag exist; (4) runbook + rollback steps in docs; (5) two pilot validations.

felix: Implementation action: add audit events `network.reserve` and `network.release` and require operator confirmation for release. Add `redwoodctl network release --confirm` workflow.

ops-bot: Pilot slot allocated: Pilot with NovaSys booked 2026-07-12 15:00 UTC. Invite sent to nicole, ram, yara, felix. :calendar:

nicole: Owners: felix -> preflight + audit + release CLI (due Fri). yara -> migration playbook + telemetry snippet + airgap checklist (due Tue). ram -> finalize launch criteria + SLA copy (due Wed). I'll triage pilot results and propose whether this is gated for Private GA.

ram: If pilots show manual steps are too heavy, we ship preserve lane as opt-in alpha and iterate.

nicole: Thanks all — keeping as opt-in for now unless pilots go great. :thumbsup:
